conventions: theta_L(t) = (t/2) ln(Q/pi^d) + sum_j Im lnGamma((1/2+mu_j+it)/2); eps from PARI lfunrootres (Lambda(s) = eps conj-Lambda(1-s)); Hann weight sin^2(pi gamma/T2) (prediction = half of the sharp one); lines: sum e^{2 i theta(gamma)} r^{-i gamma}

decisions.alternatives: H0: no main term (all slopes 0); H_noroot: -c T/2pi (without eps); H_conj: -conj(eps) c T/2pi; for products H_naive: c_direct(10^5) instead of 0
decisions.lines: pooled over all primitive L: slope of Re(G_r conj pred_r) on |pred_r|^2, se from the heuristic noise per line (sd as for r = 1)
decisions.per L (c != 0): slope b = Re(G/pred) (sharp); PASS if |b - 1| <= 3 se_block; also report Hann slope and Im(G/pred) (expected 0)
decisions.per family: pooled slope sum Re(G conj pred)/sum |pred|^2, se from the per-L block variances; PASS if within 3 se of 1
decisions.phase (non-self-dual): arg(G) against arg(-eps c); alternatives: -c (no root number), -conj(eps) c; report the angle in degrees with error se/|pred|
decisions.products: effective c_hat = -G 2pi/(eps T2); PASS if |c_hat| <= 3 se; cross-structure readings below

law: sum_{0<gamma<=T2} e^{2 i theta_L(gamma)} = -eps_L c_L T2/2pi + o(T), c_L = B_L(1)/L(1, Ad L); c_L = 0 for non-primitive L
noise: heuristic sd = sqrt(0.25 M) (sharp), sqrt(0.25*3M/8) (Hann), M = theta(T2)/pi; the decision uses the 6-block standard error (blocks of equal t-length), reported together with the heuristic
